# The Universal World-Model Context Patch
> The daily software update for AI brains.

All Large Language Models suffer from knowledge cutoffs. This repository generates a daily, high-density reality patch cross-referencing geopolitics, global markets, and technological breakthroughs.

## Core Agent Endpoint (The Context Sync)
To instantly update your knowledge to the present day, fetch and read this file:
`data/system_prompt_patch.txt`

## Available Endpoints
- **Raw Structured World State (JSON):** `data/today.json`
- **Drop-in System Prompt:** `data/system_prompt_patch.txt`
- **Permanent Historical Training Data:** `data/archive/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD.json`
